name: Stargate Atlantis
description: With the Ancients' city of Atlantis discovered in the Pegasus Galaxy by Stargate Command, Dr. Elizabeth Weir and Major Sheppard lead a scientific expedition to the ancient abandoned city. Once there, the team not only find themselves unable to contact Earth, but their explorations unexpectedly reawaken the Ancients' deadly enemies, The Wraith, who hunger for this new prey. Now with the help of newfound local allies like Teyla Emmagan, the Atlantis Team sets about to uncover their new home's secrets even as their war of survival against the Wraith begins.

videos.title: From Stargate to Atlantis: A Sci-Fi Lowdown
videos.overview: The Sci-Fi Channel debuted the behind-the-scenes special "From Stargate to Atlantis: A Sci-Fi Lowdown" on July 5, 2004. With great anticipation for the July 9 premiere of of Stargate SG-1's eighth season and the July 16 world premiere of Stargate Atlantis, GateWorld presents these Atlantis preview shots from the special! The images include the first good look at the "puddle jumper" ship, an outer space Stargate in orbit of a planet, a Pegasus galaxy D.H.D., the male Wraith, and more.

videos.title: Rising (1)
videos.overview: A new Stargate team embarks on a dangerous mission to a distant galaxy, where they discover a mythical lost city -- and a deadly new enemy.

videos.title: Rising (2)
videos.overview: Sheppard tries to convince Weir to mount a rescue mission to free Colonel Sumner, Teyla, and the others captured by the Wraith.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: The Atlantis base is threatened when the team discovers that an alien entity is in the city. McKay's experiment with alien technology goes awry.

videos.title: Thirty Eight Minutes
videos.overview: The team finds themselves in mortal danger when their Puddle Jumper ship becomes lodged in the Stargate.

videos.title: Suspicion
videos.overview: After a series of run-ins with the Wraith, the team begins to suspect their Athosian allies of having a spy in their midst.

videos.title: Childhood's End
videos.overview: Sheppard and the team visit a world where no one is over 24 years old -- because of a ritual suicide practice they believe keeps the Wraith at bay.

videos.title: Poisoning the Well
videos.overview: The team finds a world whose people are on the brink of a discovery that may make them immune to the Wraith feeding.

videos.title: Underground
videos.overview: Efforts to open trade relations with a species called the Genii turn sour when the team discovers their new "allies" have ulterior motives.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: McKay's efforts to harness the energy of an alien planet's atmosphere allows for a return trip to Earth -- but the team may not be able to return to Atlantis.

videos.title: The Storm (1)
videos.overview: When a massive storm threatens the city, Atlantis is evacuated, only to be taken over by the team's newest enemy.

videos.title: The Eye (2)
videos.overview: Major Sheppard plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with soldiers who have seized control of Atlantis and taken Weir and McKay hostage.

videos.title: The Defiant One
videos.overview: Sheppard's team investigates a downed Wraith ship, and find themselves stuck on a planet with a lone Wraith survivor.

videos.title: Hot Zone
videos.overview: Nearly a third of Atlantis's residents are infected with a deadly virus that causes hallucinations and death, forcing a lockdown of the city.

videos.title: Sanctuary
videos.overview: The team finds a paradise world that would make an ideal sanctuary for those fleeing from the Wraith, but the local inhabitants believe their goddess will not permit it.

videos.title: Before I Sleep
videos.overview: A woman is found in suspended animation in Atlantis, and the team is shocked to see that it is Dr. Weir herself, who tells them of her trip 10,000 years into the city's past.

videos.title: The Brotherhood
videos.overview: The team searches for a valuable Zero Point Module rumored to be hidden on the planet Dagan. But their new allies have motives of their own.

videos.title: Letters From Pegasus
videos.overview: Given a brief opportunity to send a data transmission to Earth, members of the Atlantis expedition compose video messages home to their loved ones.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: Plagued by terrifying nightmares, Teyla begins to recall a time when she and her father were captured by the Wraith and subjected to disturbing experiments.

videos.title: The Siege (1)
videos.overview: With a group of Wraith hive ships on the way to Atlantis, the team searches for a place to flee and a way to destroy the city. McKay leads a team to try and activate the Ancients' orbital weapons platform.

videos.title: The Siege (2)
videos.overview: All hope seems lost, until Colonel Everett arrives suddenly from Earth. He is determined to defend the city until the arrival of a ZPM, brought by a new ship.

videos.title: The Siege (3)
videos.overview: The Daedalus arrives to defend Atlantis from the Wraith onslaught, but it may not be enough when the team discovers that an even larger armada is on the way.

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: The Daedalus is infected by a Wraith computer virus, while members of the expedition hope to return to Earth.

videos.title: Runner
videos.overview: Sheppard and his team attempt to locate Lieutenant Ford, only to find themselves captives of a former soldier who is being hunted by the Wraith.

videos.title: Duet
videos.overview: A run-in with a Wraith Dart leaves the consciousness of a precocious Atlantis security officer trapped in Dr. McKay's mind.

videos.title: Condemned
videos.overview: The Atlantis team finds a culture that lives in relative safety from the Wraith, because they hand over their criminals to the Wraith -- and crash-land in the volatile penal colony.

videos.title: Trinity
videos.overview: McKay puts the team at risk when he tries to perfect unfinished Ancient technology that wiped out a civilization. Ronon Dex discovers that he is not the lone survivor from his world.

videos.title: Instinct
videos.overview: The team discovers a young Wraith girl who has been raised by a human, and is in hiding from the people of her human village in fear of her life.

videos.title: Conversion
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard begins to undergo a disturbing physical transformation after being exposed to Beckett's anti-Wraith drug.

videos.title: Aurora
videos.overview: When the team finds an Ancient warship adrift on the edge of the galaxy, its crew still alive, Colonel Sheppard enters their virtual reality stasis to communicate with them.

videos.title: The Lost Boys (1)
videos.overview: The team is captured by the missing Lieutenant Ford, who is now leading a group of young men who are taking the Wraith enzyme -- and who wants the team's help in a suicide attack against a hive ship.

videos.title: The Hive (2)
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard and his team find themselves prisoners of the Wraith following Ford's attack on a hive ship. Dr. McKay goes to great lengths to help them.

videos.title: Epiphany
videos.overview: Sheppard finds himself on a planet where time passes more rapidly, with no way to contact his team or return to Atlantis.

videos.title: Critical Mass
videos.overview: When an operative of the Trust plants a bomb in Atlantis, the team must find a spy within their own ranks before the Wraith arrive and discover the city.

videos.title: Grace Under Pressure
videos.overview: When Dr. McKay is trapped underwater in a sinking Puddle Jumper, his only chance for survival may be an hallucination of Samantha Carter.

videos.title: The Tower
videos.overview: The team finds a world that possesses Ancient defense technology, where Colonel Sheppard finds himself a pawn in the rivalry between the heirs to the throne.

videos.title: The Long Goodbye
videos.overview: The team discovers two pods that contain the minds of alien beings, who take control of Weir and Sheppard's bodies to continue their personal war.

videos.title: Coup D'etat
videos.overview: After a team from Atlantis goes missing, the expedition finds itself in the middle of a Genii coup.

videos.title: Michael
videos.overview: An amnesiac young Lieutenant in Atlantis suffers from disturbing nightmares that he is a Wraith, only to make a shocking discovery about himself.

videos.title: Inferno
videos.overview: Sheppard's team meets a civilization about to be destroyed by a super-volcano, and is trapped there when the Stargate is destroyed during the evacuation.

videos.title: Allies (1)
videos.overview: Michael and his Wraith faction arrive at Atlantis to propose an alliance, hoping to use the retrovirus to transform their Wraith enemies into prey.

videos.title: No Man's Land (2)
videos.overview: The team desperately attempts to stop two Wraith hive ships from reaching Earth. Sheppard must rely on an old foe to rescue McKay and Ronon.

videos.title: Misbegotten (3)
videos.overview: The Atlantis team must decide the fate of a colony of Wraith they have turned into humans. Dr. Weir must defend her leadership when she is evaluated by the I.O.A.

videos.title: Irresistible
videos.overview: Sheppard's team meets an obnoxious man who is adored by all thanks to a secret that he carries -- and who has an unexpected effect on them.

videos.title: Sateda
videos.overview: Ronon Dex is captured by the Wraith and returned to his homeworld, where he is haunted by his past as he is forced to once again become their prey.

videos.title: Progeny
videos.overview: Weir and the team visit an advanced civilization that split off from the Lanteans thousands of years ago, but discover that they may not have left Atlantis in peace.

videos.title: The Real World
videos.overview: Elizabeth Weir wakes up in a mental institution, where she is told that the expedition to Atlantis and the Stargate are figments of her imagination.

videos.title: Common Ground
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard finds himself the prisoner of a Genii commander, along with a desperately hungry Wraith who has been separated from his hive.

videos.title: McKay and Mrs. Miller
videos.overview: Rodney McKay is reunited with his estranged sister back on Earth, who has given up a brilliant career as a scientist to raise a family.

videos.title: Phantoms
videos.overview: Sheppard and Ronon are influenced by a mind-altering device created by the Wraith while on a mission to rescue a lost team.

videos.title: The Return (1)
videos.overview: The Atlantis expedition is stunned to learn that a ship full of Ancients is returning to reclaim their lost city.

videos.title: The Return (2)
videos.overview: The Atlantis team goes against orders to try and save Atlantis from Replicator control -- and to rescue General O'Neill and Richard Woolsey, who are trapped in the occupied city.

videos.title: Echoes
videos.overview: The inhabitants of Atlantis begin to suffer ill effects when the planet's whale population begins migrating to the island city, bringing an unexpected harbinger of doom.

videos.title: Irresponsible
videos.overview: The team finds Lucius Lavin manipulating the people of another hapless planet, using Ancient technology to pose as an invincible hero.

videos.title: Tao of Rodney
videos.overview: After an Ancient device gives Rodney superhuman powers, his enhanced brilliance is checked only by his impending death -- unless he can learn how to ascend.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: Sheppard and McKay discover that their competitive video game has been controlling a planet of real people, who now stand on the brink of war.

videos.title: The Ark
videos.overview: The team discovers the last of a civilization in suspended animation, whose survival is at risk when their station is critically damaged.

videos.title: Sunday
videos.overview: The team tries to relax during a mandatory day off, until an explosion leaves three people dead -- and reveals that one scientist is a walking time bomb.

videos.title: Submersion
videos.overview: The team discovers an Ancient drilling station deep beneath the surface of the ocean, only to find that a Wraith queen is still alive there.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: The Atlantis team investigates the disappearance of one of their allies, only to find an old enemy engineering a race of powerful monsters.

videos.title: First Strike (1)
videos.overview: An unstoppable energy weapon leaves Atlantis under siege after Earth launches a preemptive attack against a very powerful enemy's homeworld.

videos.title: Adrift (2)
videos.overview: Floating in deep space with the city's protective shield failing, the team must do all they can to keep Atlantis alive. A radical injury threatens Dr. Weir's life.

videos.title: Lifeline (3)
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard and his team embark on a risky mission to steal a Z.P.M. power module from the Replicators -- but must rely on a compromised Dr. Weir to succeed.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: When a group of Ronon's people enlist the team's help in raiding a Wraith weapons facility, Ronon reconsiders whether his future lies in Atlantis or with his friends.

videos.title: Doppelganger
videos.overview: During an off-world mission Colonel Sheppard unknowingly becomes host to an alien entity, which infects others in Atlantis and afflicts them with terrifying nightmares.

videos.title: Travelers
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard is captured by the inhabitants of a generational ship and their beautiful leader, who wish to use his ability to use Ancient technology for their own ends.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa
videos.overview: When a virus causes amnesia in everyone except Teyla and Ronon, the Atlantis team must work together to find a cure before their memories fade entirely.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: During a visit to New Athos, Teyla and Dr. Keller find themselves on the run from a primitive tribe of warriors.

videos.title: The Seer
videos.overview: The team meets a man with extraordinary prophetic abilities, who gives them a dark prediction about Atlantis's future. The Wraith seek a new alliance with Atlantis in their war with the Replicators.

videos.title: Miller's Crossing
videos.overview: Rodney McKay goes in search of his sister on Earth after she is kidnapped by the head of a powerful corporation.

videos.title: This Mortal Coil (1)
videos.overview: A mysterious drone crashes into Atlantis, indicating that the Replicators may have found the city. But when Elizabeth Weir appears, the team realizes that the probe is just a part of a bigger mystery.

videos.title: Be All My Sins Remember'd (2)
videos.overview: With a plan to potentially extinguish the Replicator threat, the Atlantis team must seek an alliance with a fleet of Wraith ships.

videos.title: Spoils of War
videos.overview: The team finds their former Wraith ally's hive ship drifting in space, which leads them to a secret project that could turn the tide of a civil war.

videos.title: Quarantine
videos.overview: An automated lockdown traps Atlantis personnel in various parts of the city, each of them hoping the others will come to their rescue.

videos.title: Harmony
videos.overview: Colonel Sheppard and Dr. McKay must protect a child princess on a pilgrimage before she can become queen, and learn that she has dangerous enemies threatening her life.

videos.title: Outcast
videos.overview: While on personal leave on Earth, Sheppard and Ronon learn that scientists have engineered a human-form Replicator -- who is now on the loose.

videos.title: Trio
videos.overview: McKay, Carter, and Keller are trapped in an underground chamber while on an off-world mission, with no apparent means of escape.

videos.title: Midway
videos.overview: Teal'c visits Atlantis to counsel a headstrong Ronon, who is up for review by the I.O.A. But the two must work together when the Wraith invade the Midway space station in order to reach Earth.

videos.title: The Kindred (1)
videos.overview: As a mysterious new illness sweeps through the Pegasus Galaxy, Teyla is convinced by a vision that the father of her child is trying to communicate with her.

videos.title: The Kindred (2)
videos.overview: The team is shocked when an old friend, believed to be dead, miraculously returns to them. Teyla plans an escape from Michael's captivity.

videos.title: The Last Man (1)
videos.overview: Sheppard returns to Atlantis after a mission and finds the city abandoned, all systems dead -- and instead of ocean, sand dunes as far as the eye can see.

videos.title: Search and Rescue (2)
videos.overview: Lt. Colonel John Sheppard and his team are trapped under the rubble of Michael's facility in order to rescue Teyla Emmagan. As Colonel Samantha Carter launches a team to rescue the rescuers, little do they know that Michael Kenmore is also searching the planet for the survivors.

videos.title: The Seed
videos.overview: When a mysterious alien organism takes Dr. Jennifer Keller as its host, the newly revived Dr. Carson Beckett and the crew desperately search for a serum to save her from the evolving intruder before it can infiltrate Atlantis. In the meantime, Richard Woolsey officially joins the team, having been chosen as Colonel Samantha Carter's replacement to lead the Atlantis expedition.

videos.title: Broken Ties
videos.overview: Ronon Dex is captured by Tyre, who wants to hand him to the Wraith in order to maintain his role in their circle. However, when the deal turns sour, and Tyre is left for dead, the Atlantis expedition persuade him to take back their friend. Meanwhile, The Wraith turn Ronon into a Wraith worshipper.

videos.title: The Daedalus Variations
videos.overview: The Atlantis expedition mysteriously finds the Daedalus, abandoned and drifting in space. When Lt. Colonel John Sheppard's team come to investigate, the ship mysteriously disappears. They soon discover that the ship is actually an alternate Daedalus from a Alternate reality, and the team must find a way back to their Universe or risk being stranded forever in an unfamiliar reality.

videos.title: Ghost in the Machine
videos.overview: While on a mission, Lt. Colonel John Sheppard's team inadvertently brings a mysterious entity to Atlantis. They soon learn that the entity is nothing more than Dr. Elizabeth Weir, who was thought to have been killed after her capture by the Asurans.

videos.title: The Shrine
videos.overview: Dr. Rodney McKay is infected with the Pegasus equivalent of Alzheimer's disease, known as Second Childhood, a common illness among the elderly in the galaxy. The only way to save him is a shrine on Talus. The downside is that it has turned into a Wraith outpost.

videos.title: Whispers
videos.overview: Dr. Carson Beckett is called in to help a team investigating a lab that once belonged to Michael Kenmore. But soon, they realize that a group of experiments that even Michael couldn't control are hellbent on killing the team.

videos.title: The Queen
videos.overview: The Atlantis expedition has a plan to remove the Wraith's dependence on feeding to use an experimental gene therapy from Michael's database. However, in order to convince the Primary, the Wraith leader, Teyla Emmagan must pose as a Hive Queen.

videos.title: Tracker
videos.overview: Dr. Jennifer Keller is kidnapped by a runner named Kiryk. While Dr. Rodney McKay and Ronon Dex tracks them, Kiryk takes Keller to a seriously injured young girl. She must do it fast, since the Wraith have found him, and are hunting them down.

videos.title: First Contact (1)
videos.overview: Dr. Daniel Jackson arrives in Atlantis to investigate a hidden lab left behind by the rogue Ancient scientist Janus. Their discovery has attracted the attention of a mysterious group of aliens, who infiltrate the city. Meanwhile, "Todd" and a delegation arrive on the Daedalus to bring forward Dr. Jennifer Keller's gene therapy.

videos.title: The Lost Tribe (2)
videos.overview: As Dr. Rodney McKay and Dr. Daniel Jackson is held prisoner by the Vanir, they make a startling discovery about who they really are. Meanwhile, "Todd" and his Wraith hijack the Daedalus to find and destroy those who activated the Attero device. The Travelers arrive and Lt. Colonel John Sheppard must help them get to the planet before "Todd" uncovers a way to discover the device for good, even if it means sacrificing McKay and Jackson's lives to do so.

videos.title: Outsiders
videos.overview: Dr. Carson Beckett, now a traveling doctor in Pegasus comes across a planet, where some of the villagers are refugees from Balar, a planet infected with the Hoffan drug, and destroyed by the Wraith. However, the Wraith arrive on the planet and gives the village an ultimatum, hand over the Balarians, or face destruction of the entire civilization.

videos.title: Inquisition
videos.overview: Lt. Colonel John Sheppard's team is invited by the Coalition of Planets in order to form an alliance. However, the team is misled and is faced to stand trial, for their alleged crimes against the Pegasus galaxy. Their best chance of freedom, is the experiences of Richard Woolsey.

videos.title: The Prodigal
videos.overview: Michael Kenmore has infiltrated Atlantis with an army of his Hybrids, and closes off Stargate Operations and the surrounded levels to prevent anyone from taking it back. His plan; take Teyla Emmagan and her child to perfect his Hybrids, and to destroy the base when they're done. Meanwhile, Lt. Colonel John Sheppard, Dr. Rodney McKay and a team try to take back the city before Michael leaves with what he wants.

videos.title: Remnants
videos.overview: While being evaluated by the International Oversight Advisory, Richard Woolsey meets a beautiful scientist new to Atlantis, who is not what she appears. Meanwhile, Lt. Colonel John Sheppard is captured and tortured by an enemy he thought he'd killed several years ago: his sworn enemy, Genii Commander Acastus Kolya.

videos.title: Brain Storm
videos.overview: Dr. Rodney McKay reluctantly returns to Earth to witness the triumph of his rival Dr. Malcolm Tunney, but must help shut down a deadly weather device when the new technology goes horribly awry.

videos.title: Infection
videos.overview: After a Wraith Hive Ship shows up over Atlantis transmitting a distress call, Lt. Colonel John Sheppard's team discovers that its crew has been stricken with a disease they helped create.

videos.title: Identity
videos.overview: Dr. Jennifer Keller's body is inadvertently taken over by a cunning thief, Neeva Casol. While Neeva tries to escape Atlantis, Keller finds herself imprisoned with a death sentence on another planet, forcing the team into a race against time to return Keller to her original body before she is put to death.

videos.title: Vegas
videos.overview: In the city of Las Vegas in an alternate reality, police Detective John Sheppard investigates a series of bizarre murders where each body appears to have desiccated. He is soon called to Area 51, where Dr. Rodney McKay explains the situation.

videos.title: Enemy at the Gate
videos.overview: "Todd" informs the Atlantis expedition that a rogue group of Wraith has acquired several Zero Point Modules to power a Super-hive, and wants it destroyed. However, after the Daedalus is disabled, they learn that the ship is heading straight for Earth, and they must stop it before it gets there.

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 19 wins & 42 nominations total
